title: Free hunt: a console bridge and an exploratory walk that find the bugs before the human does
summary: Your suite is green, the agent says done, and then you open the app and trip over an obvious break in the first ten minutes. This dump is the free-hunt practice that closes that gap: a console bridge over the live HTTP API so the agent can drive the real product, a bounded exploration protocol whose only product is a journal of anomalies, and a perimeter that lets the agent fix what it finds without wandering. The bridge and watchdog sources are inlined; the catches behind the protocol are described by mechanism — the raw logs themselves were redacted.

artifacts.note: the full free-hunt guide: console map, bridge and watchdog sources, the walk protocol, real catches, the fix perimeter and the control commands
